title: Güzel Söz

scenes.text: Cebinde hiç para yokken bile sadaka verebilir misin? Evet.
scenes.prompt: an empty open wallet lying on a wooden table beside a few keys in soft morning light, no people

scenes.text: Sabah. Otobüs kalabalık. Herkes yorgun, herkes sessiz.
scenes.prompt: inside a crowded city bus at early morning, several faceless bare-headed passengers in coats standing, grey light through the windows

scenes.text: Şoföre bir günaydın dedin. Fırıncıya bir teşekkür.
scenes.prompt: a small neighborhood bakery at morning, ONE faceless bare-headed young man in a jacket standing at the counter, ONE faceless bare-headed baker man behind it, fresh bread, warm light

scenes.text: Peygamber Efendimiz buyurdu: Güzel söz sadakadır.
scenes.prompt: a single blooming pomegranate tree in a quiet stone courtyard at sunrise, a fountain, birds, no people

scenes.text: Para gerekmez. Sadece bir kalp ve birkaç kelime.
scenes.prompt: close-up of a small glass of tea and a single folded paper note on a windowsill in morning light, no readable text, no people

scenes.text: Bugün kaç sadaka verdin? Saymaya başla.

scenes.text: Bugün güzel sözünü esirgemediğin birine gönder.
